releases.name: ChromaHum Tiles 2026-11-23
releases.body: Sound and camera now start more reliably. The camera has its own controller with a Restart camera button, and the screen says what is wrong when the camera is blocked or in use by another app. A tap wakes the sound if the browser has paused it.

jobs.description: An instrument that turns camera colors into sound, with tiles, patterns, and an infinite canvas.

releases.name: Road Layers 2026-11-22
releases.body: The Composite length is now a picker from 6 seconds up to 5 minutes, or as long as the clips allow, with 30 seconds as the default instead of 6. When a clip limits the length, the status says which clip it is and how to get a longer build.

jobs.description: Road Layers stacks cars from several drive clips onto one road in the browser.

releases.name: Campus 2026-11-23
releases.body: Campus version 3. Home picks up where you left off and recommends a next video, with a bottom navigation bar and a new navy, green, and gold look. Recommendations now search your subject instead of your bucket name, and a Junk button removes bad picks. The player has a screen off mode and a fullscreen button for picture in picture.

jobs.description: A phone friendly learning tool that plays videos and logs what you build in a credit transcript.

releases.name: Campus API 2026-11-23
releases.body: Search now returns lessons only, using education categories, a three minute minimum, and relevance order. Added a junk list so rejected videos stay out. Entries now carry their subject.

jobs.description: The backend for Campus that stores sources, logged work, and the transcript.

releases.name: Pipe Weave 2026-11-22
releases.body: Fill canvas now works with any preset. It keeps growing pipes until the screen is covered, tops up gaps, and reports the coverage. The fill style has a new Current rules choice.

jobs.description: A pipe drawing toy where pipes turn, split, and weave over and under each other.

releases.name: Itchy Troll 2026-11-22
releases.body: The scout looked over the repos for new candidates.

jobs.description: An agent that publishes finished apps to a game publishing site.

releases.name: Hub View 2026-11-23
releases.body: Added a car picker menu with makes and nested models and a paint picker for outside body panels. Added part search and a MORE sheet with specs, manual, and links tabs. Added an Extra explode mode that spreads out every part of every assembly. Added manual diagrams for a 2006 Crown Victoria and reshaped the Accord floor pan, trunk floor, and carpet to clear the wheels.

releases.name: Hub View 2026-11-22
releases.body: Created Hub View, a three dimensional exploded view that started with a wheel hub and grew into a full car with 25 assemblies. Added a 1982 Accord sedan and a 2007 Prius fitted to blueprints, with a car switch, a retro spec sheet panel, and body shapes that were refined through the day. Parts show an info card in the scene, an opacity slider, and matched manual diagrams. A menu saves the card as an image, finds a part in online shops, and builds a buy sheet with part numbers and tire sizes that prints on one page. Automatic camera zoom was removed and both cars were mirrored so the steering wheel is on the left.

jobs.description: A three dimensional exploded view of cars with part cards, manual diagrams, and a buy sheet.

releases.name: Explode 2026-11-23
releases.body: Created Explode, a photo app. Pick a photo, tap anything in it to cut that object out as a piece, then slide to explode the pieces apart and drag them around. Undo, Reset, and a Holes toggle are included.

jobs.description: A photo toy that cuts objects out of a picture and spreads the pieces apart.

releases.name: Pipeline Builder 2026-11-22
releases.body: Added the Pipeline Builder source, a tool that builds a software stack from tool choices, with Builder, Randomizer, Diagram, and Templates tabs. Added Open in Conveyor Sim buttons to the builder and to templates.

jobs.description: A stack planning tool with a builder, randomizer, diagram, and templates.

releases.name: Threat Atlas 2026-11-23
releases.body: Story mode. A new STORY tab walks the incidents in order as twenty seven chapters, rotating the globe and building the map year by year. Intel list now marks which incidents are in the story. Corrected the Triton attribution to Russia.

jobs.description: Interactive globe of security threats with layers, filters, and country intel.

releases.name: Repo Find 2026-11-22
releases.body: Added Conveyor Sim links. Each teardown can open in Conveyor Sim two ways, as built from its layers or as the rebuild, and the builder stack, rolled stacks and templates each have an open in conveyor sim button. Layers with no machine yet show up as gaps there. Info banners now start closed behind an i button. Tap the i to open or close one.

jobs.description: Search and watch tool for code repos, archives, and sites.
